source.author: SeniorEmployment932

quote: 1000 r2 Tranquility Bloom ... gave me 1473 pigment
notes: Firsthand player comment reports 1,000 quality-rank-2 Tranquility Bloom purchased and 1,473 pigments received, without naming individual pigment item(s) or ranks. Output is therefore aggregate only; do not allocate all 1,473 to Powder Pigment item 245807 without confirming the output identity/rank. Midnight Milling takes 10 herbs per nominal operation (mechanics.md M6), giving 100 nominal ten-herb operations; actual completed casts may exceed 100 if Resourcefulness refunds were reused. Author previously said blue tools; exact resourcefulness rate, tool configuration, specialization, completed cast count and collection date not stated. 100 nominal casts are derived from 1,000 initial herbs / 10 per mill, NOT directly observed. Date is comment publication; study date is unknown. Source is before the 2026-03-31 prospecting hotfix, which does not apply to milling. Do not use as a directly measured per-output expectedQuantity until pigment identity and cast denominator are confirmed.
stats: Blue tools mentioned earlier by same author; Resourcefulness and precise specialization not stated
